title: In basic training when President Kennedy is assassinated
description: Larry remembers being about a month into basic training when President Kennedy was shot. The assassination was November 22, 1963 — almost exactly a month after his October 28 induction. His own memory, offered unprompted in a 2026 phone call, independently corroborates the DD-214's 1963 induction date over the old family estimate of 1964.
larrysRecollection: He was about a month into basic training when Kennedy was shot.
researchNotes: From the 2026-08-12 phone call (research/interviews/2026-08-12-call-notes.md). The location of basic training is still unknown — a question for a future conversation. A remembered national event is a strong anchor: everyone of his generation remembers where they were that day.
